full_judgment: 2. In Civil Revision No. 4787 of 2003 the fact relevant for disposal of the rule are that the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Noakhali (Now Feni) in the capacity as in charge of Vested and Non-residents Property instituted Title Suit No. 6 of 1981 / 390 of 1974 in the Court of learned sub-ordinate Judge, Noakhali for declaration that the order of attachment dated 23-7-1973 made in Money Exaction Case No 10 of 1973 and the auction held there under dated 27-9-1973 and the said auction having had confirmed on 30-11-1973 to be illegal, collusive, void and not binding upon the plaintiffs contending, inter alia, that the suit land appertaining to mouza Raipur, Police Station Feni, Khatian No. 271, Plot No. 3078 measuring 4 decimals of land with a 2-storied building constructed therein belonged to Monoranjan Banik who left the then East Pakistan for India, after 1960 and accordingly the said property was declared as Enemy Property vide Case No. 1032 of 1967-68. Possession of the same was taken over by a Magistrate and that was leased out with one Nur Mohammad but the lessee failed to renew the lease period and thereafter the Civil Defence Committee being represented by Krishna Dhar Banik prayed for taking lease of the property but failed to pay rent. That property was being possessed by Feni Bastra Hawker Samabaya Samity and that Samity prayed for taking lease. At that stage it came to the notice of the plaintiff that the property was sold in auction as stated above. The attachment as made in Execution Case was held against law of Enemy Property and, as such, the plaintiff came forward for a declaration as stated above.
